newsitem.title: USA: Compass completes another Texas buy.
newsitem.headline: Compass completes another Texas buy.

text.p: Compass Bancshares Inc said Tuesday it had completed its acquisition of Central Texas Bancorp Inc and its subsidiary, Texas National Bank of Waco.
Compass said the acquisition brings about $206 million in assets, $188 million in deposits and $18 million in equity to Compass' Texas franchise.
With the addition of Texas National Bank's two Waco locations, Compass now operates 15 bank offices in central Texas in Austin, Round Rock, Temple, Belton, Salado and Georgetown.
Compass said its Texas bank offices total 105, including new offices under construction, and statewide assets increase to more than $4.9 billion.
Compass Bancshares is a $12.1 billion bank holding company with 224 offices in Alabama, Florida and Texas.
